Deny labels, a missing `--require-label` opt-in, or a non-allowlisted author/association make an issue skip_denied / skip_not_allowed; stop-the-line issues still escalate (even with a deny label) but never automate over a denied, claimed, duplicate or PR-linked issue; closed issues are skip_closed

Active `<slug>-i<N>` cards, open PRs that Fixes/Closes/Resolves #N (same-repo closingIssuesReferences only), and `duplicate of #M` / older look-alike titles yield in_progress, verify_existing_fix and duplicate; a corrupt, directory or dangling-symlink kanban.db fails closed as blocked_dedup_error; REST issue reads paginate past pull requests

Issue text is untrusted data: never executed, quarantined with injection_signals, and commands come only from the .factonio/ harness committed at HEAD (dirty, staged or untracked working-tree copies are ignored and flagged)

Reproduction needs >= 2 runs with explicit fresh_state true and distinct non-blank run_ids (1-of-2 is flaky; bare booleans never count); verify_existing_fix needs full 40-char (or 64-char SHA-256) head_sha/base_sha, 2 before-runs on one full base commit SHA (never the PR head; missing, abbreviated or mixed commits are rejected) and 2 after-runs at the exact PR head_sha with no run_id reuse, and any still-reproducing head run after a deterministic base is fix_incomplete, the only verdict that allows a duplicate fix
issue_intake_triage / issue_intake_verify_fix rows land in trail.db without issue text

Every open issue and PR is enumerated before `--limit`: a newer stop-the-line issue is triaged first even behind 30+ older issues or outside a `--label` filter, and duplicate detection always uses the unfiltered open-issue pool
Linked PRs beyond the first 100 open PRs are found in list and `--issue N` modes; hitting the issue or PR page safety cap sets issues_truncated / pr_dedup_truncated and blocks automation

Every open PR's closingIssuesReferences is paginated (100 per page, then per-PR follow-up pages up to 20): a 51st or 105th closing reference routes to verify_existing_fix in list and `--issue N` modes; a nested page cap, an outer open-PR or nested page with missing, null, non-object or non-boolean-hasNextPage pageInfo, hasNextPage without a non-empty endCursor, or a failed follow-up query sets pr_dedup_truncated (with pr_dedup_reason) and blocks automation, and `--json` always prints valid JSON (never an AttributeError); same-repo `Fixes https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/issues/N` URLs count as links, other repos never do

A malformed `pullRequests.nodes` entry (null, number, string, no positive integer `number`, null, missing or non-string title/body (GitHub `String!`; an empty string is valid), or a present non-string url/headRefName/headRefOid/baseRefName or non-boolean isDraft) or `closingIssuesReferences` container/node (missing, null, non-object, boolean/non-positive/non-integer `number`, present non-string `url`, non-object non-null `repository`, present non-string `repository.nameWithOwner`) on any inline or follow-up page is never skipped: `pr_dedup_truncated` true with a `pr_dedup_reason`, every issue `blocked_dedup_error` / `automate: false` in `issues --json`, `--issue N` and `factonio_triage_issues`; valid empty `nodes: []` pages and PRs with `title: "Fix bug", body: ""` stay ready
